name: Prop
description: Environmental props, static objects, destructible items, and interactive props

overrideComponents.comment: Mass in kg for physics simulation

postCreateNotes: Set MeshObject.Object to your prop model
Configure RigidBody mass and physics properties
Set up collision shapes if not auto-generated
Configure interaction prompts for interactive props

variants.name: static
variants.description: Static decorative objects with no physics
postCreateNotes: Set MeshObject.Object to your prop model
Use for trees, rocks, buildings, street furniture, etc

variants.name: destructible
variants.description: Props that can be destroyed or damaged
postCreateNotes: Set MeshObject.Object to intact prop model
Add RplComponent — SCR_DestructionMultiPhaseComponent requires it or the engine silently skips adding the destruction component
Configure m_aDamagePhases (SCR_DamagePhaseData: m_fPhaseHealth + m_PhaseModel swap) and m_fBaseHealth
Reference a matching HitZone_*.conf preset under "Additional hit zones" (e.g. HitZone_Wood_Planks.conf, HitZone_Metal_Light.conf) instead of authoring hit zones from scratch
Set m_DestroySpawnObjects (SCR_DebrisSpawnable/SCR_ParticleSpawnable) for the final destruction phase
Set m_bPassDamageToChildren 1 if this prop has separately-modeled attached sub-parts

variants.name: interactive
variants.description: Pickup-able or usable props (ammo boxes, containers, gear) — adds inventory storage and an interact prompt

overrideComponents.comment: Mass in kg for physics simulation
Add Attributes.SCR_ItemAttributeCollection.ItemDisplayName for the inventory UI, and PreviewRenderAttributes for the inventory preview icon framing
Add an ActionContexts.UserActionContext with a Position (PointInfo Offset) — this is the world-space anchor for the interact prompt

postCreateNotes: Set MeshObject.Object to your prop model
If a closer vanilla base exists for this item family (e.g. AmmoBox_Base.et), inherit that instead of Props_Base.et directly
Without both SCR_UniversalInventoryStorageComponent and ActionsManagerComponent this is just decorative geometry — the character controller cannot interact with it
SCR_EditableEntityComponent is not used on individual props in vanilla — Game Master editability is wired at the composition/catalog level, not here
